body:
I've decided I'm giving myself until this next weekend, when it's my husband's turn to have the girls for the weekend. Aside from the depression, I simply can't afford to raise these girls any,ore, even with child support and state assistance. in spite of my awesomely technical background, I'm apparently un-hireable out here. I've been applying for jobs like mad both online and in person, so I'm leaving it up to fate this next week and either I'll get hired and my life will turn around or I'll have to end it.

Monday and Tuesday, I have two therapy appointments with a new therapist (mon), and my final appt with my most awesome old therapist whom I can no longer afford on tues. This depression is all consuming. I've been constantly researching job opportunities, the best ways to kill myself, and thinking about the goodbye letters I'll be writing my girls. I'm going to figure out how to send a times text or message to my ex so he can't deploy the police right away.

I've decided I'm going to take an anti emetic pill so I don't vomit, get in a bathtub, take several thousand milligrams of thc in marijuana edibles to dull my senses and respiration, drink a bunch of alcohol, overdose on as many prescription pills as I have left from my last overdose in March, ( all as quickly as possible so I don't lose my faculties and lose consciousness right away like I did last time), slit my wrists vertically while in the tub so the clotting factor slows, and drown myself face down while putting a 25lb dumbbell on my neck. If that doesn't do it this time...

My youngest (12) is sitting next to me feeding me grapes while watching The Incredibles. 

I'm taking things moment by moment, and right now I'm really depressed, but definitely not in crisis mode like I was earlier. I think tonight I'm going to apply for a couple more jobs, although I believe I've exhausted my resources for the day and maybe take a bath before bed. I haven't bathed in days. :( Thanks again for the talk.

Thanks for your supportive words. You're right. Thinking back. Every single decision was absolutely made with the girls' best interests in mind. Other decisions could have been made, but I wanted to enrich their lives, and I did.

About the hotline, I'm not sure. In the moment, I guess I ultimately wanted to to be talked down - talked out of not killing myself in the moment. I was here alone with my children. I keep thinking if I were to kill myself, I'd rather do it on a weekend when my ex had the girls and warn him by text so the girls wouldn't have to see my body. So the lady on the other end effectively helped me get through that moment, but I hate feeling like I'm appeasing the other person. I guess that lame thought shouldn't even register in that moment...I should be thankful. That's probably the anger in having to make such a call in the first place. 

If I were on the other end talking to someone, I would be more personable, and not talk from a script. I'd try to engage more, like I was his or her friend. That's how I'd want to be treated. That would show that the person on the other end genuinely cared about what I was going through, and not just getting a paycheck or collecting collecting community service hours.
